name: Gavi
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

notes: Gavi, or Cortese di Gavi, is a dry white made from Cortese.

blurb.text: A dry white from the Alessandria province in Piedmont, near the Ligurian border.
